title: Expected distribution
view: Shared back-of-head base (visuals/distribution_bases/head_back): skull and grey head seen from behind, so the patient's right is on the image right; right-sided block.
teachingPoint: A greater occipital nerve block numbs the back of the scalp on one side, from the occiput up toward the vertex; behind the ear and the neck are spared.
claims: Skin: the back of the scalp on one side, from the superior nuchal line up toward the vertex, midline to about the line above the ear (greater occipital nerve, C2; record anatomy; ASRA 2019).
Not shaded: behind the ear (lesser occipital), the back of the neck (third occipital and cervical), the other side. No bone is shaded.
Right-sided block, patient's right on the image right in this back view; one tone, key shown under the image in the app.
